$comment: Where the main story stands, and what's still open in a region: the Journal's Main story section when no chapter is in hand (src/ui/storystatus.js picks which apply; the owner, 2026-10-03). {title}, {giver}, {town}, {level}, {n}, {of}, {cls} are filled from the sim and the quest words.
level: Next: {title}, once your hero reaches level {level}.

fens.title: Act II is done
fens.text: The Abbess is down and the choir-lamp is glass on the floor. Ilse has read the ledger twice: the Cult was mining the dead, and the buyer's mark is the Kell Assay's. The road up to the Cinder Reach, and Act III, opens in a later update. Until then, the Fens and the Vale still have work in them.

leads.brannoc: Wickham Keep: someone is still chained in the second-floor hall where Captain Garrow kept him. Go down and see.
leads.standard: The Old Barrows: the Standard of the Third Legion still holds the third-floor hall, and the barrows road with it.
leads.warren: The Scrag Warren, under the north range past the mill: Hedda, by the well, has lost hens to the goblins.
leads.chronicle: The Vale's Chronicle: {n} of {of} pages found. The Chronicle tab says where the rest were lost, and together they say where something was buried.
leads.milestone: The Ninth Milestone is open: the legion's strongroom, out where the old road runs on past the Deepdelve mine.
leads.trial: A trial for your {cls}: {giver} in {town} teaches it.
leads.board: The Lantern Guild's board, inside the Tired Mule, has new jobs every day.
leads.toadking: Toadking's Mound, out in the reeds: the Toadking keeps the second-floor hall, and somebody tied up beside his berth-book.
leads.wren: Toadking's Mound: the Toadking is down, and the woman tied in his Boat Hall is still there. Go back down and cut her loose.
leads.choir: The Drowned Abbey: the Drowned Choir still sings in the second-floor hall. Somebody should stop them.
leads.owed: Wren has something she wants settled. Ask her, at the Stilt House or on the road.
leads.tower: The Mere Tower: the ferry at Saltmere's quay crosses to it. Climb it as far as you can.
leads.fensboard: The Lantern Guild's board, at the Drowned Eel, has new Fens jobs every day.
